about_the_game:
About:

At Trade Academy, students are trained for the world of stock trading. 

Students engage in 1-on-1 stock duels.

  • Buy Low, Sell High, invest in dividends to skyrocket your profits.

  • Invest your way: Day trades, safe trades, and even risky crypto trades. 

  • Trade fast to earn METER for special moves.

  • Attack, Shield or even Boost your payouts with strategic meter use

Win by growing your net worth or driving the opponent into bankruptcy.

What is Arcade Trading?

$tock Fighter is designed to be approachable by anyone, despite the source material. It uses real trading concepts and abstracts them into easy-to-understand gameplay mechanics. You don't need to be a trader to follow along.

Think of it like a sports anime where players pull out magical invisible "Ghost Pass" or unstoppable "Dempsey Roll. 

For example, stock data is abstracted into "Stock Patterns". With one glance, you'll know that a GROW stock is likely to climb slowly over time. 

The challenge isn't reading the stock data, it isn't even the trading. It's being able to read the available stocks to map your way to victory. Do you invest in dividends for cash payouts? Do you invest in stable stocks to rapidly build meter? Do you attack or do you defend? 

Features: 

  • One part fighting game, one part stock market simulation

  • Fast-Paced Arcade Action (Most fights take ~3 minutes)

  • Easy-to-learn stock patterns

  • Peer-to-peer multiplayer for challenging your friends

  • Plenty of tutorials to teach you the ropes

It's time to trade!
